name: chatchat
description: Browser-first local AI Parliament: you ask, they debate.

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:extension: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && vite build --config vite.extension.config.ts && node scripts/validate-extension.mjs
scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run check:web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && node dist/tests/core.test.js && node dist/tests/provider-sdk.test.js && node dist/tests/teach-mode.test.js && node dist/tests/test-speech.test.js && node dist/tests/council-bridge.test.js && node dist/tests/window-health.test.js && node dist/tests/gate-b-proof.test.js && node dist/tests/council-theater.test.js && node dist/tests/ai-house.test.js && node dist/tests/extension-summon.test.js && node dist/tests/extension-gate-b.test.js && node dist/tests/recipe-candidate.test.js && node dist/tests/house-committees.test.js && node dist/tests/house-committee-prompt.test.js && node dist/tests/royal-onboarding.test.js && node dist/tests/browser-chronicle.test.js
